reviews.title: 2TB Review
reviews.comment: Excellent for what I needed it for, and a decently priced deal, but I probably should have bought one with a bigger TB Size above 2TB. I Had Way more Data than I expected and a 4TB would've been more effective, but Next time I'll get a bigger one next time. The Device was an Easy install and came with all needed to install and use the product.
